Messages.Author: Kude
Messages.Body:
Fifth Tradition: Hospitality

Action, cost 1 blood

+1 stealth action. Requires a ready prince or justicar.
Move 4 blood from the blood bank to a vampire other than this acting vampire.

So, my question is. A vampire means also your vampires in the uncontrolled region and torpor? So you could play the card with active vampire, and give the 4 blood to vampire in your uncontrolled area?

I don't see why not, for it doesn't exclude the card to "controlled only" or "ready only" like other cards do.

If (and it seems foolish, but legit) the card does work to uncontrolled, it makes Govern the UNaligned and Scouting mission tad worse (not much, but still).

Rulebook 1.6.1.4  wrote:
>
> Targets. If a card is played on another card, or selects or chooses or otherwise targets another card, the target card must be in play (i.e., controlled). Vampires in the torpor region are eligible targets by default, but vampires in the uncontrolled region and contested cards are not.
>

Messages.Author: Nagorak
Messages.Body: If Fifth Tradition worked on uncontrolled vampires, then it would be superior to the Fourth Tradition in every way.
